scientific_scope: GUI workflow illustrations with existing public experimental measurements. The two-frame Series combines different acquisitions; it is not a time series, controlled temperature experiment or algorithm accuracy benchmark. Inputs were not aligned for the difference example.
observations: Imported stored mutrans from both XDI files: 408 and 612 points.

Background showed one AUTOBK spline and no normalization fit overlays.
Changing wavelet R maximum from 6 to 5 angstrom automatically updated the map and its aligned R marginal without Calculate; restored 6.
Assistant, Groups and Parameters remained visible together; model/access menus opened. No prompt submitted and no access settings changed.
Created a named Series with Use loaded groups, previewed Flat maximum over 0–30 eV, then calculated wavelet integral over both frames (2/2 complete).
Difference used reference frame 1. Right selected frame 2 and changed the displayed spectrum while retaining the fixed reference and saved integral trend.
